intro: The ten most-played Roblox games this week. Throw Food For Animals storms in at No. 6, Forsaken and Dandy's World are back, and Practical Basketball drops out.
method: Ranked by player counts on the public tracker Endgametools (snapshot Nov 9, 2026, 22:56 UTC), cross-checked with Livecounts (Nov 10, 11:32 UTC). The two disagree in places: Livecounts had Throw Food For Animals at No. 4 and 99 Nights in the Forest at No. 7.

entries.name: Steal An Egg
entries.note: Untouchable at No. 1 with about 567,000 players on Nov 9.

entries.name: Murder Mystery 2
entries.note: Climbing again: about 489,000 players on Nov 9, and up 24.6% in 24 hours on Livecounts.

entries.name: Brookhaven RP
entries.note: Holding No. 3 with about 342,000 players on Nov 9.

entries.name: Blox Fruits
entries.note: Steady at No. 4 with about 205,000 players on Nov 9.

entries.name: Adopt Me!
entries.note: Unchanged at No. 5 with about 152,000 players on Nov 9.

entries.name: Throw Food For Animals
entries.note: New: about 145,000 players on Nov 9, and Livecounts even had it at No. 4 on Nov 10.

entries.name: RIVALS
entries.note: Down one, with about 104,000 players on Nov 9.

entries.name: Forsaken
entries.note: Back in the top 10 (about 95,000 players on Nov 9) after adding the killer Azure.

entries.name: Dandy's World [ALPHA]
entries.note: Back in the top 10 with about 90,000 players on Nov 9.

entries.name: 99 Nights in the Forest
entries.note: Hanging on at No. 10 with about 87,000 players on Nov 9.
